title: Themes: form column widths, group/grid gaps and 24 px button height come from the theme

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
Found during the theme audit for #2039 (`upstream/main` `31f8d03d7`). Companion to #2025 (open PR #2038).

What is fixed today:
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:33`: `pub const LABEL_W: f32 = 120.0;` (property label column width).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:35`: `pub const CTRL_W: f32 = 96.0;` (numeric/combo field width).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:37`: `pub const GROUP_GAP: f32 = 6.0;` (vertical gap after a collapsible section).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:142`: `prop_grid` row vertical gap hardcoded as `4.0` instead of reading `pal.item_spacing_y` or a theme grid-gap key.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:189`: `group_open` inner margin hardcoded as `Margin { left: 2, right: 0, top: 0, bottom: 2 }`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:363` and five pages duplicate a hardcoded `24.0` button height instead of reading `control_height` (`ui.spacing().interact_size.y`) or a theme `button_height` key: `fixtures_page.rs:24`, `machine_page.rs:29`, `setup_settings_page.rs:26`, `stock_page.rs:25`, `wcs_page.rs:30`.

Done means:
- `LABEL_W`, `CTRL_W`, `GROUP_GAP`, `prop_grid` row gap, `group_open` margin, and page/action button heights come from `Tokens` (or read existing tokens like `control_height` / `item_spacing_y` where intended), with local `BUTTON_H` constants retired.
- Once #2038 merges, `assets/themes/theme.json.example` includes any new keys and its key-set test passes; default dark/light layout stays intact and narrow-window tests pass.
